limits: Real current authored normal template and fixed stage monster level,12/20 targets, actual stage-clear and stage-end builds, World movement, body collision, skills, HP, mana and cooldowns.

This is a controlled finite pack test. No invulnerability, attack suppression, refill, synthetic healing or post-measurement player multiplier is applied. Each encounter starts fresh with its own resolved full-health build.
Death, timeout and no-cast/no-damage cases stay in denominators. A higher rate alone is not acceptance when ending characters die.
Normal packs are separate from future authored swarm targets and camp group budgets. These measurements do not prove natural sustained field rates, server rewards or one-shot threshold crossing.
The seed distribution represents engine random outcomes, not human player behaviour.
